obernants.approximation_semantics: Conditional model; finite observations, not universal proof.
obernants.assumptions: Valid leaf domains, representable arithmetic, successful allocation.
obernants.observation_scope: Public joins and explicit adapter identities.
obernants.operator: In tagged observation space U for seven finite domains, exclude outputs violating flow=matching size, deletion component predicates, LCA distance identity, substring membership/count agreement, prefix-free optimal weighted paths, palindrome length sandwich, or unit-work costs. Conditional absent-behavior model, not merely rejected fixtures.

obernants.operator: For tagged output y define R^-1(y)={x in fixture domain: all joined public observations and adapters equal y}. Retain shared graph/text/trie identities. Cardinality, cost or length leaves many compatible inputs; uniqueness is not claimed. Sequential inverse is an existential join on the SAME intermediate, not independent choices from leaf fibers.

obernants.operator: Adapter makes s->L, L->R, R->t capacities one with disjoint offsets. Flow value equals matching size; positive middle-edge flow is itself a matching; final source-side cut capacity equals value. Reverse cardinality-k fiber retains all graphs of maximum matching size k, not one matching or edge order.

obernants.operator: For indexed undirected multigraph G, bridge iff c(G-e)>c(G), articulation iff c(G-v)>c(G), removed vertex excluded. Euler existence requires connected nonisolates and zero/two odd degrees; returned IDs permute original edges and each consecutive pair matches its named edge. Loops count twice and parallel IDs stay distinct. Reverse trail plus indexed endpoints constrains edges; connectivity counts alone cannot recover them.

obernants.operator: Parent forest -> symmetric adjacency preserves vertices. If a=LCA(u,v), dist(u,v)=depth(u)+depth(v)-2depth(a); cross-tree pairs return None. Ancestor lies on both parent chains. BFS distances forget root choice; inverse retains all rootings compatible with LCA observations, not a unique forest.

obernants.operator: SAM.contains(q) iff KMP positions nonempty, including empty query. Distinct nonempty substrings equals n(n+1)/2 minus adjacent suffix-array LCP sum and literal substring-set size. Count inverse is nonunique; bounded query membership constrains only the observed language. LCP and suffix indices use the same text.

obernants.operator: Codes are prefix-free original-symbol leaves. Sum w_i*length_i equals sum of descendant weights across trie edges. Independent subset recurrence C(S)=sum(S)+min[C(A)+C(S-A)] gives optimum full binary tree cost for >=2 symbols; empty zero, singleton stipulated one-bit code. Prefix codes reconstruct their trie, but scalar cost loses topology and weights; zero weights and ties remain admissible.

obernants.operator: LPS length(t)=LCS length(t,reverse(t)); longest contiguous Manacher palindrome <= LPS <= n. This relates lengths; arbitrary LCS witness need not be palindromic. Reverse fiber retains every string meeting observed lengths, not recovered symbols or positions.

obernants.operator: Amount graph 0..a with x->x+c for positive coins embeds unlimited minimum count as BFS distance. Separately m>=1 square matrices side d>=1 cost (m-1)*d^3=minimum_coins([1],m-1)*d^3, since every parenthesization has m-1 merges. Restricted unit-work embeddings, not a general coin/matrix reduction. Reverse costs leave denominations, dimensions and parenthesizations ambiguous.
